name: verify-watch
summary: A strict one-line grammar for proving a finished item is really live (VERIFY: url=... has="..."), an allowlist of hosts, and an emit check that refuses lines that would pass on any page.

env.VERIFY_HOSTS: optional: use this allowlist file instead
env.VERIFY_TZ: optional: IANA time zone for the per-day cap, default UTC
env.VERIFY_NO_SOURCES: optional: comma list of sources that never get a suggested line, default inbound-mail
